target.title: feat(config): add compaction.thinkingLevel to override thinking level during compaction
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

Compaction always shares the session's current thinking level. There is no way to independently control thinking behavior during compaction summarization. Users who want to save tokens/cost during compaction or avoid thinking artifacts in summaries had no option to disable thinking for compaction alone.

This adds `agents.defaults.compaction.thinkingLevel` config option. When set, compaction uses this thinking level instead of the session's current level. Precedence: `config.compaction.thinkingLevel` > inherited session `thinkLevel` > `"off"` (default).

## Evidence

Proxy log comparison — same session, before and after setting `compaction.thinkingLevel`.

**Before** — session thinking = `"high"`, `compaction.thinkingLevel` unset — compaction request passes `thinking: "high"`, response includes `reasoning_content`:

```
Request 903:
{
  "model": "Qwen3.6-27B-FP8",
  "thinking": { "enabled": true, "level": "high" },
  "stream": true,
  ...
}

Response 903:
{
  "choices": [{
    "delta": {
      "reasoning_content": "thinking block content...",
    }
  }]
}
```

**After** — same session, set `compaction.thinkingLevel: "off"` — compaction request omits thinking, response has no `reasoning_content`:

```
Request 907:
{
  "model": "Qwen3.6-27B-FP8",
  "stream": true,
  "stream_options": {
    "include_usage": true
  },
  "max_completion_tokens": 16000
}

Response:
{
  "id": "chatcmpl-986428eb-dc58-4a7d-bc2d-881504084088",
  "choices": [{
    "index": 0,
    "delta": {
      "role": "assistant",
      "content": "...compaction summary...",
      "reasoning_content": null,
      "tool_calls": null
    },
    "finish_reason": "stop"
  }],
  "usage": {
    "prompt_tokens": 289,
    "total_tokens": 648,
    "completion_tokens": 359
  }
}
```

Key observations:
- Same session, same model, same compaction trigger — only the config changed
- **Before**: request 903 — `thinking: { enabled: true, level: "high" }` → `reasoning_content` present (~2-3K thinking tokens)
- **After**: request 907 — no thinking param → `reasoning_content: null` (359 completion tokens, no thinking overhead)
- Token count drops significantly when thinking is disabled via config

## Verification

- Unit tests pass (12 new/updated tests across 3 test files)
  - `config.compaction-settings.test.ts` (9 tests) — config parsing
  - `compact.thinking.test.ts` (6 tests) — thinkLevel precedence rules
  - `schema.help.quality.test.ts` (23 tests) — help/label coverage
- Config schema validates all 8 ThinkLevel values
- Embedded-agent-runner (`compact.ts`) reads `compaction.thinkingLevel` with correct precedence
- Codex native compaction warns that `compaction.thinkingLevel` is ignored (no-op scoped)
- Schema labels and help text updated

## Files Changed

| File | Change |
|------|--------|
| `src/config/zod-schema.agent-defaults.ts` | Add `thinkingLevel` to compaction zod schema |
| `src/config/types.agent-defaults.ts` | Add `thinkingLevel` to `AgentCompactionConfig`, dedupe `provider` |
| `src/agents/embedded-agent-runner/compact.ts` | Read `compaction.thinkingLevel` from config as fallback |
| `src/agents/sessions/agent-session.ts` | Add `compactionThinkingLevel` option to `runCompactionWork` |
| `src/config/schema.labels.ts` | Add label for `compaction.thinkingLevel` |
| `src/config/schema.help.ts` | Add help text |
| `src/config/schema.help.quality.test.ts` | Add key + enum expectations |
| `src/config/config.compaction-settings.test.ts` | 4 new config parsing tests |
| `src/agents/embedded-agent-runner/compact.thinking.test.ts` | 6 new precedence tests |

## Compatibility / Migration

- **Backward compatible**: unset config preserves existing behavior
- **New optional field only**, no migration needed
